## 模式 1：百分比分母 - JOIN 丢人 / 虚增

-- "What percentage of Segment-S customers spent more than X in 2013?"

FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID FROM yearmonth
           WHERE Consumption > X AND yearmonth BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312') y

WHERE c.Segment = 'S';
